name: NFL Outcome Engine V2
purpose: Build a model-first NFL player-outcome engine whose central projections are accurate enough to be useful on meaningful active players. Sportsbook data is forbidden from model inputs and may be used only as a downstream comparator after a forecast is frozen.
governing_rules: Every feature must have an explicit football mechanism and an assigned prediction layer.
Every retained feature or model must improve out-of-time prediction on the player population we actually care about.
Do not use Monte Carlo to create the core point projection or rescue a weak predictive model.
Do not judge success primarily on full-universe rows dominated by backups, nonparticipants, or easy zero outcomes.
No market/head is promoted because another market works.
No same-week or postgame information may enter a pregame forecast.
No rescue tuning after a holdout or forward result is observed.
No production replacement until forward evidence earns it.

burned_for_v2_development: 2022-2025 historical data already used in prior NFL research
2026 week 4 explicitly burned as forensic diagnostic data
data_policy.clean_forward: 2026 week 5 onward only, and only forecasts actually created before the relevant cutoff after the V2 candidate is frozen. Missed cutoffs are never backfilled.
data_policy.sportsbook_comparator_policy: Allowed only after model forecast freeze and only for downstream benchmark/execution evaluation.
data_policy.injury_censoring: Pregame availability uncertainty is model responsibility. Clearly documented in-game injury/ejection/abnormal early removal remains in the raw ledger but is separately flagged and excluded from clean full-game point-accuracy metrics.

primary_population.name: meaningful_active_players
primary_population.definition: Players forecast pregame with material expected role who actually participated normally.
primary_population.secondary_population: Full candidate universe remains reported for calibration and accounting but can never be the headline accuracy population.

prediction_layers.football_question: Will the player be available and how much can he realistically play?
How many offensive opportunities will this game create for the team?
How should this specific opponent change expected opportunity or efficiency?
prediction_layers.rule: A matchup feature may only affect components for which a football mechanism is explicit and out-of-time improvement is demonstrated.

prediction_layers.football_question: What should the player produce per opportunity in this matchup?
What does the model actually think the player will produce?
prediction_layers.rule: The point projection must exist before Monte Carlo and must be reconstructable from upstream model components.

prediction_layers.football_question: How uncertain is the point projection and what alternative outcomes are plausible?
prediction_layers.rule: Monte Carlo is downstream uncertainty propagation only.

candidate_families: ensembles only when they improve honest out-of-time accuracy
model_competition.selection_rule: Complexity never earns promotion by name. Simpler wins ties. Statistical improvement alone is insufficient if absolute player-level accuracy remains unusable.

mandatory_baselines: recent weighted role x recent weighted efficiency
market consensus only as a post-freeze comparator where timestamp-safe data exists

evaluation.diagnostic_decomposition: For every material miss, identify whether the dominant error entered through team environment, player opportunity, role share, efficiency, availability, or unmodeled/censored event.

promotion_gates.rule: Each market must beat V1 and strong simple baselines on meaningful active players and demonstrate useful absolute accuracy before clean-forward confirmation.
promotion_gates.absolute_accuracy: Numeric thresholds must be preregistered from historical development evidence before any clean-forward V2 scoring. They may differ by market and position. No thresholds may be chosen after seeing forward results.
promotion_gates.forward_confirmation: Required. V2 remains research/shadow until a predeclared forward sample passes.
promotion_gates.partial_promotion: Allowed. A strong rushing head may promote while receiving or passing remains research.

blocked_sources.some_2026_coverage_pressure_features: LIMITED_OR_STALE; must not be represented as current if source is not current

prohibitions: No sportsbook lines or odds as model inputs.
No postgame participation/snap data as same-game predictors.
No hidden feature soup without layer routing.
No using full-universe easy zeros as the headline accuracy claim.
No treating 100000 simulations as evidence the underlying model is accurate.
No production/UI promotion before scientific certification.
